_readme: Tuned per-timeframe defaults, applied automatically based on TIMEFRAME. Anything set explicitly in .env or the shell overrides these. Run 'python rsi_midline_bot.py tune' to re-tune with walk-forward validation (it updates this file only if the winner holds up out-of-sample), or edit by hand and update 'tuned'/'notes' so the evidence stays with the numbers.

1Day.notes: Hand-tuned on QQQ,GLD,IWM,SPY over 1095d of 1Day bars, 70%/30% walk-forward split, from a wider grid than tune's (asymmetric bands incl. 55/40, 65/45; MA 0/50/100/200; trail 0/8/12). 55/40 band: train avg +36.5%, out-of-sample test avg +20.7% vs prior 60/40 profile +19.3% and buy&hold +24.0% (13 test trades, all 4 symbols positive OOS). MA0 scored identically OOS; kept MA50 as downtrend-entry insurance. Full 1095d: QQQ +39.1%, GLD +118.7%, IWM +45.2%, SPY +60.2% (see backtest_results.csv 2026-07-11).

1Hour.notes: Untested guess: intraday chop should make band + volume + trend filters help here as they did on 15Min. Run 'backtest' with TIMEFRAME=1Hour before trusting. MA200 = 200 hourly bars (~6 weeks).

15Min.notes: 1y backtest (2025-07 to 2026-07, SPY/AAPL/MSFT): raw 50-cross churns ~800-950 trades/yr and loses badly. Band 55/45 + volume 1.5x + MA200 was best on every symbol (SPY +15.9% with 44% win rate, MSFT -0.8% vs -23% hold; AAPL improved but still negative). Volume confirmation is the single biggest intraday improvement. Still trails daily-bar buy&hold overall.

5Min.notes: Untested guess: even choppier than 15Min, so filters matter more; expect worse results overall. Run 'backtest' with TIMEFRAME=5Min before trusting.

1Min.notes: Not backtested and not recommended: at 1-minute bars, spread and slippage dominate any RSI edge. Kept only so the profile lookup never falls through silently.
